question: What is the ultimate status of all scriptural meaning and of the Vedas and other teachings?
premises: The entire meaning of scripture is established as the nature of the supreme principle.
The Vedas and other teachings appear as distinct scriptural portions.
Those portions belong to the Maya-born level of expression.
inference: All scriptural meaning is grounded in the supreme principle, while the Vedas and other teachings are Maya-born portions of that teaching.
plain_english: Therefore the entire meaning of scripture is established as the nature of the supreme principle; hence even these Vedas and others are Maya-born portions of teaching.
